Each step precisely corresponds to the ancient process of the Mystery Ritual. The magic circle will slowly rotate with a pale purple shimmer as the movements are performed, and the incantations will be accompanied by a low hum, full of ritualistic atmosphere. \n During this period, surrounding players can obtain a temporary skill, and using the temporary skill can acquire a note of secret knowledge. \n The user gains +4 Intuition and +2 Erudition. ref_en: On your way to investigate the missing persons case, you encounter that pair of siblings from your dream and are blocked by "Hyacinth" and his men while tracking them. With Rebecca's help, you successfully repel them and learn information about the Moon Servant. After discussion, you continue to investigate the missing persons cases of the cleaner Karl, the wealthy merchant Charlie, and the textile worker Jenny. But after using divination to find Jenny and arriving at Central Plaza, you accidentally see Rozanne disintegrate into a Torrent of Information and dissipate. You immediately return to Blackthorn to report, and after summarizing and analyzing the clues with Frye and Leonard, you discover that the missing persons case is related to the bronze mirror and the Knowledge Crown. source_cn:
从进装备箱的第一天起，它就知道自己和别人不太一样，它身边出现的大多是漂亮的礼帽，高的，圆的，支棱的，脱帽致意的时候帽檐轻轻一翻，优雅极了。
可它呢？每次脱帽，帽尖都会甩来甩去，鞋靴笑话它，披风躲着它，连最安静的护符都忍不住说：“请离我远一点，那个尖尖戳到我了。”
“抱歉……我只是在练习脱帽致意……”
它一个帽在角落里练了好久，但总歪歪扭扭，一点都不优雅。
“不会有人想戴上我的……”它沮丧极了，索性瘫成一张软塌塌的饼。
“哇，这真是一顶完美的巫师帽。”一只手从天而降，拿起它扣在了脑袋上，“巫师帽就该这样，帽尖塌下来才好看。”
它第一次知道原来自己其实是巫师帽。
从那以后，它再也不练脱帽致意了——巫师帽嘛，歪歪扭扭的就很有礼貌了。
ref_en:
From the first day it entered the equipment box, it knew it was different from the others. Most of those around it were beautiful top hats—tall, round, or stiff. When they tipped their brims in greeting, they did so with such elegance. 
 But what about it? Every time it tipped its brim, the tip would flop around. The boots mocked it, the cloak avoided it, and even the quietest amulet couldn't help but say: "Please stay away from me, that pointy tip is poking me." 
 "Sorry... I was just practicing tipping my hat..." 
 It practiced in the corner for a long time, but it was always crooked and not elegant at all. 
 "No one would ever want to wear me..." It was so depressed that it just slumped into a soft, flat pancake. 
 "Wow, this is truly a perfect wizard hat." A hand descended from the sky, picked it up, and plopped it onto a head. "A wizard hat should be like this; it looks best when the tip flops down." 
 It learned for the first time that it was actually a wizard hat. 
 From then on, it never practiced tipping its hat again—after all, for a wizard hat, being crooked is quite polite.

source_cn: 赛程安排</> <Highlight>首场四方联赛</>将在开服<Highlight>第一周周日中午12:00</>通过对俱乐部的综合评判划分赛区、分组，并于<Highlight>当日晚18:00</>公示赛区以及分组。联赛以<Highlight>每两场对阵为一轮</>，每一轮持续<Highlight>两周</>，开服第一周周日晚<Highlight>20:00</>开启首轮联赛（特殊），后续调整为每周六晚<Highlight>20:00</>开启四方联赛。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>赛制规则</> 每轮比赛由两场对阵组成。每轮第一场开始前，本组第1、2名，第3、4名，第5、6名以及第7、8名将分别进入不同的比赛小组，并在满足该规则的前提下<Highlight>随机分配</>。第一场比赛结束后，各比赛小组<Highlight>前2名进入胜者组</>，后2名进入败者组。第二场比赛将分别进行胜者组与败者组对决，并根据比赛结果确定本轮<Highlight>第1至第8名</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>晋降级规则</> 每轮第二场比赛结束后，将于当周周六21:00进行本轮晋降级：<Highlight>圣名组及圣名组以上</>分组内前两名晋级上一分组，末两名降级至下一分组；<Highlight>英杰组及英杰组以下</>组内第一名晋升两组，第二名晋升一组，第七名降级一组，第八名降级两组。其中<Highlight>传奇组、史诗组、旅者组</>为特殊分组：传奇组第一、二名晋升一组，第六、七名均降一组，第八名降两组；史诗组第一、二名晋升一组，第七名降级一组，第八名降级两组；旅者组第一名晋升两组，第二名晋升一组，第七、八名降级两组；挑战者组第一名晋升两组，第二、三名晋升一组。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>联盟组规则</> 排名在旅者组之后的俱乐部将根据<Highlight>俱乐部非凡评分总和</>划分至<Highlight>挑战者组</>（前八名）及后续<Highlight>联盟组</>（<Highlight>联盟组不参与升降级</>）。联盟组的俱乐部将在每场联赛开始前<Highlight>自动匹配</>其它俱乐部组成联盟，以联盟形式参与四方联赛，联盟内<Highlight>所有俱乐部成员</>均可入场参战，联盟中<Highlight>排名最高俱乐部的会长</>将在局内自动获得<Highlight>联赛指挥权限</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>赛季重置</> 每个新赛季开始时联赛将<Highlight>重新划分赛区</>，届时将按照<Highlight>上一赛季联赛成绩</>重新匹配对手构建新的赛区。
ref_en: Schedule </> <Highlight> The first Four-Way League </> will divide divisions and groups based on a comprehensive evaluation of clubs on <Highlight> the Sunday at 12:00 PM of the first week </> after the server opens, and the divisions and groups will be announced at <Highlight> 6:00 PM that same day </>. The league consists of <Highlight> two matches per round </>, with each round lasting <Highlight> two weeks </>. The first round of the league (special) will start at <Highlight> 8:00 PM </> on the Sunday of the first week, and subsequent Four-Way Leagues will be adjusted to start every Saturday at <Highlight> 8:00 PM </>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Tournament Rules </> Each round consists of two matches. Before the first match of each round, the 1st/2nd, 3rd/4th, 5th/6th, and 7th/8th place teams in the group will be placed into different match groups and <Highlight> randomly assigned </>, provided this rule is met. After the first match, the <Highlight> top 2 </> of each match group enter the Winners' Bracket, and the bottom 2 enter the Losers' Bracket. The second match will feature matchups within the Winners' and Losers' Brackets respectively, and the <Highlight> 1st to 8th place </> for the round will be determined based on the results. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Promotion and Relegation Rules </> After the second match of each round, promotion and relegation for the round will take place on Saturday at 9:00 PM: <Highlight> For the Holy Name Group and above </>, the top two in the group promote to the higher group, and the bottom two relegate to the lower group; <Highlight> For the Hero Group and below </>, the first place in the group promotes two groups, the second place promotes one group, the seventh place relegates one group, and the eighth place relegates two groups. Among them, <Highlight> Legendary Group, Epic Group, and Traveler Group </> are special groups: Legendary Group 1st and 2nd promote one group, 6th and 7th both relegate one group, 8th relegates two groups; Epic Group 1st and 2nd promote one group, 7th relegates one group, 8th relegates two groups; Traveler Group 1st promotes two groups, 2nd promotes one group, 7th and 8th relegate two groups; Challenger Group 1st promotes two groups, 2nd and 3rd promote one group. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Alliance Group Rules </> Clubs ranked after the Traveler Group will be divided into the <Highlight> Challenger Group </> (top eight) and subsequent <Highlight> Alliance Group </> (<Highlight> Alliance Group does not participate in promotion/relegation </>) based on <Highlight> total club Beyonder rating </>. 恭逢黑夜女神诞辰圣祭，圣赛缪尔教堂谨定于冬礼日举行守夜弥撒。现将当日活动安排敬告如下：

时间：晚间10:00 准时开始
地点：圣赛缪尔教堂前广场（若遇雨雪，移至教堂正厅）
主持：安东尼·史蒂文森主教

注意事项（请务必遵守）：
守夜弥撒是我主诞辰最为神圣的仪式，请诸位信众严肃对待：
1. 请勿迟到。弥撒准点开启，迟到者须在广场外围静立等候，待特定环节结束后方可入场。
2. 保持肃静。仪式期间禁止交谈、喧哗、随意走动。
3. 着装得体。建议穿着深色或素色正装，避免鲜艳色彩。
4. 遵从引导。现场侍从将引导站位与跪拜次序，请予配合。
ref_en:
In celebration of the Evernight Goddess's birthday festival, St. Samuel Cathedral has scheduled a vigil mass on the Winter Festival. The arrangements for the day's activities are hereby notified as follows:

Time: Starts promptly at 10:00 PM
Location: Square in front of St. Samuel Cathedral (in case of rain or snow, move to the main hall of the cathedral)
Presider: Bishop Anthony Stevenson

Notes (Please be sure to comply):
The vigil mass is the most sacred ceremony of our Lord's birthday; please treat it seriously:
1. Do not be late. The mass starts on time. Latecomers must stand quietly outside the square and can only enter after specific segments are completed.
2. Maintain silence. Talking, making noise, or walking around at will is prohibited during the ceremony.
3. Dress appropriately. It is recommended to wear dark or plain formal attire, avoiding bright colors.
4. Follow guidance. On-site attendants will guide the standing positions and kneeling order; please cooperate.

由一根根豌豆藤蔓构筑起的青绿森林，摇晃的秋千不知勾起了谁的童年回忆。

在众多童话故事中，“杰克与豌豆”被罗塞尔赋予了蒸汽与机械的奇想。他将平凡的豌豆藤描绘成由齿轮驱动的奇迹，让杰克用智慧改造巨人的城堡，将吃人的怪物变为烤蛋糕的伙伴。那也是贝尔纳黛好奇心最重的时候，“爸爸，巨人是弗萨克人吗？”“城堡怎么建在云上的呢，云不是水吗？”“要多高才能看到城堡呀，坐飞空艇能够看到吗？我想上去看看！”……

多么古怪的问题都会获得回应，多么天真的想法都会得到满足。
ref_en:
A green forest constructed from beanstalks; the swaying swing brings back someone's childhood memories.

Among the many fairy tales, "Jack and the Beanstalk" was imbued with steam and mechanical whimsy by Roselle. He depicted the ordinary beanstalk as a miracle driven by gears, letting Jack use his wisdom to renovate the giant's castle and turn the man-eating monster into a partner who bakes cakes. That was also when Bernadette was most curious. "Papa, is the giant a Feynapotter?" "How is the castle built on the clouds? Aren't clouds water?" "How high do you have to be to see the castle? Can you see it if you take an airship? I want to go up and see!"...

No matter how strange the questions, they would receive a response; no matter how naive the thoughts, they would be satisfied.

ref_en: After reading it, I found it really wasn't just an absurd essay. After space-time was reversed, Emperor Roselle and George III swapped souls, and he became the King of Loen. He won a great victory in the war of 1350 and created countless epoch-making inventions, but he still couldn't untangle the entanglement of the Church of Steam, and eventually lived a complex life.\nAfter George III sat in Roselle's position, he was unusually low-key until he died in madness in his later years.\nFate is like a cunning snake! What a legendary pair of emperors!

<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找风暴追逐</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【风暴追逐】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【风暴追逐】玩法图标，并根据图标指引在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 发起挑战</>
到达目标地点后，与竞速爱好者对话，选择开启竞速挑战。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 完成竞速</>
进入竞速位面后，根据路线指引前进，在倒计时结束前抵达终点即可完成挑战。
<Assistant_Title1>【助手提示】</>
触碰<Assistant_Property1>白色光圈</>可获得加速效果。
触碰<Assistant_Red>红色光圈</>受到减速效果，建议尽量避开。
挑战失败后可重新发起挑战！
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Storm Chasing】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>Racing is the epitome of a storm. Drive your steam car at full speed through the streets, ride the waves across dangerous shoals, and use the Leap of Spirituality to soar through the air as you follow in the footsteps of the Lord of Storms to win the glory and gifts that belong only to you.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding Storm Chasing</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Storm Chasing] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Storm Chasing] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Initiating a Challenge</>
After arriving at the target location, speak with the racing enthusiast to start the racing challenge.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Completing the Race</>
After entering the racing plane, follow the route markers and reach the finish line before the countdown ends to complete the challenge.
<Assistant_Title1>【Assistant Tip】</>
Touch the <Assistant_Property1>white ring</> to gain an acceleration effect.

和女孩一起埋在废墟下时，它表面的符文还和刚附着时一样精美。
“如果谁能记得我就好了。”
它总觉得，很久以前也有人这么说过。
ref_en:
These boots have walked through too many places, so many that they could coexist peacefully with their owners. 
 Some wore them to dance amidst the wine stains of a wedding, some carried them to laugh among the petals of a celebration, some liked to step into the silver-like sea waves amidst the sound of the tide, and some were afraid of wearing them out, so they placed them in a glass display case. 
 When buried under the ruins with the girl, the runes on their surface were as exquisite as when they were first attached. 
 "If only someone could remember me." 
 It always felt that someone had said this a long time ago.

source_cn: 下一扮演等级解锁时间：%s 认知经验获取</> 足够的认知有利于扮演的推进。完成主线、支线、时代与漫游任务，以及参与各类日常玩法（包括<Yellow>轻松躺赢、以战养战、世界冒险</>等），均可获得大量认知经验。当你重历“愚者”先生的历史时，受“嫁接”的力量影响，同样可以获取属于自己的那份认知经验。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>等级限制规则</> 当非凡者的扮演等级达到当前上限，且认知经验已满时，将无法继续获取认知经验。直到开放新的扮演等级限制，方可继续提升。当扮演等级提升至最终上限后，继续积累的认知经验将用于开启神性等级——超越限度的认知，人性将越来越淡薄，离神越来越近。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>扮演中的人性与神性</> “万物皆有神性，当扮演超出限度，你将逐步走向最初的神性。” 非凡者通过日常的体验、任务与探索，不断接受关于这个世界的认知，并将其转化为<Yellow>认知经验</>。积累认知经验，可逐步提升自我的<Yellow>扮演等级</>，通过扮演以巩固精神与存在的稳定性。 然而，认知与扮演本身蕴含风险，扮演的每一步也在支付着代价。当扮演等级提升至最终上限后，人性将无法维持扮演带来的影响——后续的扮演将开始塑造神性。非凡者将在扮演中逐步走向神性，从而提升<Yellow>神性等级</>。 为防止短时间内接收过量认知导致精神崩溃，您被“愚者”先生赋予了限制等级的保护性祝福。在当前的扮演等级或神性等级下，身体与精神必须经历足够的适应与沉淀，方能突破等级限制，承受更高层次的认知，迈向下一阶段。
ref_en: Next Acting Level unlock time: %s Cognitive Experience Acquisition</> Sufficient cognition is beneficial for the advancement of Acting. Completing main quests, side quests, Era and Roaming quests, and participating in various daily activities (including <Yellow>Easy Wins, War-Driven Growth, World Adventure</>, etc.) will grant a large amount of Cognitive Experience. When you relive the history of Mr. Fool, influenced by the power of "Grafting," you can also obtain your own share of Cognitive Experience. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Level Limit Rules</> When a Beyonder's Acting Level reaches the current cap and Cognitive Experience is full, you will no longer be able to gain Cognitive Experience until a new Acting Level limit is opened. After the Acting Level reaches the final cap, accumulated Cognitive Experience will be used to unlock Divinity Level—cognition beyond the limit makes humanity increasingly faint, bringing you closer to God. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Humanity and Divinity in Acting</> "All things have divinity; when Acting exceeds the limit, you will gradually move toward the original divinity." Beyonders continuously accept cognition about this world through daily experiences, quests, and exploration, converting it into <Yellow>Cognitive Experience</>. Accumulating Cognitive Experience can gradually improve your <Yellow>Acting Level</>, consolidating the stability of your spirit and existence through Acting. However, cognition and Acting themselves contain risks, and every step of Acting comes with a price. When the Acting Level reaches the final cap, humanity will be unable to maintain the influence brought by Acting—subsequent Acting will begin to shape divinity. Beyonders will gradually move toward divinity during Acting, thereby increasing their <Yellow>Divinity Level</>. To prevent mental collapse from receiving excessive cognition in a short period, you have been granted a protective blessing by Mr. Fool that limits your level. At the current Acting Level or Divinity Level, your body and spirit must undergo sufficient adaptation and precipitation before you can break through the level limit, withstand higher levels of cognition, and move to the next stage.

source_cn:
你一觉醒来，却成了另一个人——霍伊大学历史系毕业生，有一个哥哥和一个妹妹，口袋里只剩几枚便士。这算什么？一场离奇的梦，还是命运开的一个玩笑？

穿越，这是克莱恩给自己的第一个答案。
他以为这只是一次意外的偏离，以为只要找到回家的路，就能回到原来曾经的家，回到那个不需要扮演任何人的世界。于是他小心翼翼地披上“克莱恩”的外壳，学习非凡，总结扮演法则，从泛黄的典籍里试着拼凑出一条归乡的路。

可故事并未朝着他所期待的方向发展。长辈失控，队长牺牲，身不由己地卷入了一场与己无关的巨大阴谋。他死过一次，又从深渊的边缘死而复生。当他再度睁开眼时，发现自己早已不再是这个世界的过客，那些真实存在过的温暖与记忆，已经成了他维系人性、不可或缺的锚点。

只是，现在的它们都被无情地碾碎了。于是他暂时收起“回家”的执念，走上另一条路——复仇。不再徘徊，不再犹豫。他开始谋划，开始变强，戴上小丑的面具，在灰雾之上以“愚者”之名俯瞰众生。
“总有一天，我会回去的。”他低声说，“但不是现在。”
还有太多账没有算清，太多人还没等到迟来的审判。回家，似乎成了一个遥远而漫长的目标。
“但幸运的是，我是一个有耐心的人。”

灰雾之上，“愚者”先生缓缓睁开了眼睛。
ref_en:
You wake up, but you have become someone else—a history graduate of Khoy University, with an older brother and a younger sister, and only a few pence left in your pocket. What is this? A bizarre dream, or a joke played by fate? 
 
 Transmigration, this is the first answer Klein gave himself. 
 He thought it was just an accidental deviation, thinking that as long as he found the way home, he could return to his former home, to the world where he didn’t need to act as anyone. So he carefully put on the shell of “Klein,” learned about Beyonders, summarized the acting principles, and tried to piece together a way home from the yellowed classics. 
 
 But the story did not develop in the direction he expected. The elder lost control, the captain sacrificed, and he was involuntarily involved in a huge conspiracy that had nothing to do with him. He died once, and died and resurrected from the edge of the abyss. When he opened his eyes again, he found that he was no longer a passerby in this world, and those warm memories that had truly existed had become the anchors he needed to maintain his humanity. 
 
 It’s just that they have all been ruthlessly crushed now. So he temporarily put away the obsession of “going home” and embarked on another path—revenge. No more wandering, no more hesitation. He began to plan, began to become stronger, put on the mask of a clown, and overlooked all living beings above the gray fog in the name of “The Fool.” 
 “One day, I will go back.” He whispered, “But not now.” 
 There are too many accounts that have not been settled, and too many people who have not waited for the late judgment. Going home seems to have become a distant and long goal. 
 “But fortunately, I am a patient person.” 
 
 Above the gray fog, Mr. “The Fool” slowly opened his eyes.

source_cn: 玩法介绍</> 在命运时刻战场中，非凡者分为两个阵营，每场对局持续<Highlight>4分钟</>，对局结束时分数较高的一方获胜，积分相同则依次判断击杀数和伤害量，高的一方获胜，均相同则随机一方获胜。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>机制说明</> <Highlight>积分获取：</>可通过拾取增益光点、击杀、助攻、进入纷争漩涡争夺来获取。 <Highlight>汇集锚点：</>对局内会出现汇集锚点并持续<Highlight>15秒</>，届时根据锚点<Highlight>需求人数</>进入锚点，人数达到要求后持续<Highlight>3秒</>后将会将本阵营非凡者集结于此，同时参与集结的非凡者将获得限时属性加成。 <Highlight>纷争漩涡：</>战场中间会出现纷争漩涡，纷争漩涡<Highlight>倒计时结束时</>留在漩涡内的非凡者将平分积分。 <Highlight>增益光点：</>战场中会出现增益光点，拾取增益光点会获得<Highlight>积分及属性加成</>。
ref_en: Gameplay Introduction</> In the Fate Moment battlefield, Beyonders are divided into two factions. Each match lasts for <Highlight>4 minutes</>. The side with the higher score at the end of the match wins. If scores are tied, the side with more kills wins; if kills are also tied, the side with more damage wins. If all are equal, a random side wins. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Mechanism Explanation</> <Highlight>Score Acquisition: </>Can be obtained by picking up buff orbs, kills, assists, and entering the Vortex of Strife to compete. <Highlight>Gathering Anchors: </>Gathering Anchors will appear in the match and last for <Highlight>15 seconds</>. When they appear, Beyonders must enter the anchor based on the <Highlight>required number of people</>. Once the requirement is met, after <Highlight>3 seconds</>, the Beyonders of that faction will be assembled there, and participating Beyonders will receive a temporary attribute bonus. <Highlight>Vortex of Strife: </>A Vortex of Strife will appear in the middle of the battlefield. When the <Highlight>countdown ends</>, Beyonders remaining in the vortex will split the points equally. <Highlight>Buff Orbs: </>Buff orbs will appear on the battlefield. Picking them up grants <Highlight>points and attribute bonuses</>.
GvG Historical Battle Record Interface Introduction

source_cn:
岁月如棋，落子无悔，一步踏错，便是百年。

一副古老的棋盘静置于案，被放缓的时间里，隐约能看到一只大手和一只小手下棋的旧影。罗塞尔曾与贝尔纳黛对弈，谈起“烂柯棋局”的传说——那山中樵夫观棋片刻，人间已过百年。

那时贝尔纳黛听不懂什么是烂柯，不懂为什么父亲总会把棋子下在交叉点上，也不懂什么是“观棋不语真君子，落子无悔大丈夫”，她只记得耍赖悔棋时父亲会轻拍她的头顶，手掌宽厚而温暖。
ref_en:
Years are like a game of chess; once a piece is placed, there is no turning back. One wrong step, and a century passes.

An ancient chessboard sat quietly on the desk. In the slowed time, one could vaguely see the old shadows of a large hand and a small hand playing chess. Roselle once played against Bernadette and spoke of the legend of the "Rotten Axe Chess Game"—the woodcutter watched the game for a moment, and a century had passed in the human world.

Back then, Bernadette didn't understand what a "rotten axe" was, didn't understand why her father always placed his pieces on the intersections, and didn't understand what it meant to be "a true gentleman who watches in silence and a real man who never regrets his move." She only remembered that when she tried to cheat or take back a move, her father would gently pat her head, his palm broad and warm.

source_cn:
它是湖里一只安静的巨龟。
它看过很多年风吹过湖面，也看过很多人来来去去。 
岸边来了会流血的人，会祈祷的人，会变成石像的人，湖水变得越来越暖，暖得发胀，暖得发痛，每一寸血肉都在疯长， 连呼吸都像要裂开。
它开始在水面上旋转、跳跃、咆哮， 挡住每一个想靠近湖心的人。 它分不清自己是在驱赶别人， 还是在向谁求救。
ref_en:
It is a quiet giant turtle in the lake. 
 It has watched the wind blow across the lake for many years, and it has watched many people come and go. 
 People who bleed, people who pray, and people who turn into stone statues have come to the shore. The lake water has become warmer and warmer, warm to the point of swelling, warm to the point of pain. Every inch of flesh is growing wildly, and even breathing feels like it is about to tear apart. 
 It begins to spin, jump, and roar on the surface of the water, blocking everyone who tries to approach the center of the lake. It cannot tell if it is driving others away or calling for help from someone.

铁黑色的斧身沉甸甸的，闪电和飓风般的花纹蔓延着这把斧头的表层。
戴里克睁眼的时候，看见的就是这把“飓风之斧”。
那是“愚者”的赐予。
他在白银城的天空下握紧这把斧头。这里终年电闪雷鸣，闪电是唯一的光。
他想象自己的每一次挥斧！劈出闪电的斧头，将那片黑暗撕开裂缝。闪电一道接一道地从斧刃迸发，和天空的雷鸣交织成网。 
这把斧头在他手中，就是风暴本身。
ref_en:
The iron-black axe head was heavy, with patterns like lightning and hurricanes spreading across the surface of the axe. 
 When Derrick opened his eyes, this was the "Hurricane Axe" he saw. 
 It was a gift from The Fool. 
 He gripped this axe under the sky of the City of Silver. Here, there is thunder and lightning all year round, and lightning is the only light. 
 He imagined every swing of his axe! The axe that cleaved lightning tore open a crack in that darkness. Bolts of lightning erupted one after another from the axe blade, weaving into a net with the thunder in the sky. 
 This axe in his hand was the storm itself.

<Assistant_Title1>Befriend Connections</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions:</>
With the help of the Sealed Artifact <Assistant_Property1>Corridor of History</>, you can search for figures scattered throughout history within the gaps of time ({SendAnswer:人脉|550}), get to know them, and borrow power from the past. 
<Assistant_Title2>Method of Befriending:</>
Click <Assistant_System>Menu - Connections - Befriend Connections</> to enter the interface, then click Befriend 1 time/5 times to proceed. 
<Assistant_Title2>Befriending Cost:</>
Each time you befriend, it consumes one {SendAnswer:历史明灯|556}. 
<Assistant_Title2>Befriending Rules:</>
1. In befriending events, every 5 attempts guarantees an Epic or higher quality Connection. 
2. If you do not obtain a Legendary Connection after 24 consecutive attempts, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed a Legendary Connection every 40 attempts. Once a Legendary Connection is obtained, the count resets and the probability returns to the base rate. 
3. The pity counts for permanent befriending events and limited-time befriending events accumulate separately within their respective events and do not affect each other. 
4. For permanent befriending events, you can make a wish for a specific Connection to increase the probability of obtaining it. 
5. When you obtain a duplicate Connection, you will receive additional {SendAnswer:投影片段|557}. If the Connection has already reached its limit or you have enough materials to reach the limit, the number of projection fragments received will increase. Projection fragments can be used to exchange for Historical Beacons and specific Connections in the {SendAnswer:人脉商店|558}. 
<Assistant_Title2>Befriending Record:</>
You can view the records for specific types of befriending events by going to <Assistant_System>Connections - Befriend Connections - Corresponding Event - Record</>. 
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[人脉]|550}, {SendAnswer:[关系]|551}, {SendAnswer:[人脉许愿]|555}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Befriend Connections</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions:</>
With the help of the Sealed Artifact <Assistant_Property1>Corridor of History</>, you can search for figures scattered throughout history within the gaps of time ({SendAnswer:Connections|550}), get to know them, and borrow power from the past. 
<Assistant_Title2>Method of Befriending:</>
Click <Assistant_System>Menu - Connections - Befriend Connections</> to enter the interface, then click Befriend 1 time/5 times to proceed. 
<Assistant_Title2>Befriending Cost:</>
Each time you befriend, it consumes one {SendAnswer:Historical Beacon|556}. 
<Assistant_Title2>Befriending Rules:</>
1. In befriending events, every 5 attempts guarantees an Epic or higher quality Connection. 
2. If you do not obtain a Legendary Connection after 24 consecutive attempts, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed a Legendary Connection every 40 attempts. Once a Legendary Connection is obtained, the count resets and the probability returns to the base rate. 
3. The pity counts for permanent befriending events and limited-time befriending events accumulate separately within their respective events and do not affect each other. 
4. For permanent befriending events, you can make a wish for a specific Connection to increase the probability of obtaining it. 
5. When you obtain a duplicate Connection, you will receive additional {SendAnswer:Projection Fragments|557}. source_cn:
罗塞尔·古斯塔夫已经死去一百五十多年了，但他的名字从未被遗忘。
        在因蒂斯的首都特里尔，他的雕像依然矗立在广场中央。每年他的诞辰，人们都会举行盛大的活动来纪念他。鲁恩王国的工厂里，工人们使用着他发明的机器，孩子们在学校里学习着他推行的知识。迷雾海的商船沿着他开辟的航道航行，南大陆的殖民地里，冒险者们讲述着他的传说。
        他是一个穿越者，一个异乡人，一个永远回不去故乡的游子。但他也是蒸汽之子，因蒂斯共和国的执政官，凯撒大帝，罗塞尔大帝，一个强大的非凡者，一个父亲——一个改变了整个世界的人。
        他犯过错，走过弯路，被污染，被背叛，最终陨落于白枫宫。但他也创造过，保护过，爱过，留下过一个时代的辉煌与文明。
        也许正如他在日记中写的那样：如果能够重来，他或许会选择做一个普通人，回到那个有炸鸡和可乐的世界，陪在父母身边，过着平凡而温暖的一生。但历史没有如果。罗塞尔·古斯塔夫无可选择地成为时代的主角。
        我们对罗塞尔大帝的一生了解得还不够多，但我们知道他是——一个时代的开端，一个闪耀的传奇，一个永不褪色的名字。
ref_en:
Roselle Gustav has been dead for over one hundred and fifty years, but his name has never been forgotten. 
 In Trier, the capital of Intis, his statue still stands in the center of the square. Every year on his birthday, people hold grand events to commemorate him. In the factories of the Loen Kingdom, workers use the machines he invented, and children learn the knowledge he promoted in schools. Merchant ships in the Fog Sea sail along the routes he pioneered, and in the colonies of the Southern Continent, adventurers recount his legends. 
 He was a transmigrator, a foreigner, a wanderer who could never return to his homeland. But he was also the Son of Steam, the Consul of the Intis Republic, Caesar the Great, Emperor Roselle, a powerful Beyonder, a father—a man who changed the entire world. 
 He made mistakes, took detours, was corrupted, and was betrayed, eventually falling in the White Maple Palace. But he also created, protected, loved, and left behind the brilliance and civilization of an era. 
 Perhaps as he wrote in his diary: if he could do it all over again, he might have chosen to be an ordinary person, returning to that world with fried chicken and cola, staying by his parents' side, and living an ordinary and warm life. But history has no 'ifs.' Roselle Gustav had no choice but to become the protagonist of the era. 
 We do not know enough about Emperor Roselle's life, but we know what he was—the beginning of an era, a shining legend, a name that never fades.

<HighLight>太阳能量</>不少于2点时方可施放。消耗所有<HighLight>太阳能量</>，对锁定目标造成*d点物理伤害并触发<HighLight>无暗</>。
<HighLight>烈阳</>状态下获得额外效果：损失自身*f**当前生命，对目标造成自身当前生命或已损生命mul(*f**,*f)的<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="15">固定伤害</>（取最大）。对8米内其他拥有<HighLight>异端</>效果的敌方掷出小枪造成spellfielddisc(*id)点物理伤害并触发<HighLight>无暗</>。
击败敌方玩家时，重置本技能冷却时间。

<FaintYellow>无暗</>：消耗3/4/5点太阳能量时，基础伤害提高*d**/mul(*d**,2)/mul(*d**,3)。若目标为玩家且生命低于*d**，此次伤害的基础值提高15%（<HighLight>烈阳</>状态下提高30%）。此次伤害击败敌方玩家时，短时间后将<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="21">净化</>目标。
ref_en:
<HighLight>Solar Energy</> must be at least 2 points to cast. Consumes all <HighLight>Solar Energy</>, dealing *d physical damage to the locked target and triggering <HighLight>Unshadowed</>. 
<HighLight>Blazing Sun</> state grants an additional effect: Lose *f** of your current Health, and deal <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="15">Fixed Damage</> to the target equal to the greater of your current Health or lost Health multiplied by mul(*f**,*f). Throw small spears at other enemies within 8 meters affected by <HighLight>Heresy</>, dealing spellfielddisc(*id) physical damage and triggering <HighLight>Unshadowed</>. 
Defeating an enemy player resets this skill's Cooldown. 

<FaintYellow>Unshadowed</>: When consuming 3/4/5 points of Solar Energy, base damage is increased by *d**/mul(*d**,2)/mul(*d**,3). If the target is a player and their Health is below *d**, the base value of this damage is increased by 15% (increased by 30% in the <HighLight>Blazing Sun</> state). source_cn:
警告传说研究会的所有人！
1、不得长时间直视水面！
2、不得采摘湖心水底的那一颗睡莲！
3、若在水边听见呼唤，不要回应！不要回应！不要回应！
　　愿传说长存，愿我们小镇长青。
ref_en:
Warning to everyone in the Legend Research Society! 
 1. Do not stare directly at the water surface for a long time! 
 2. Do not pick the water lily at the bottom of the lake!

source_cn: 她的灵破碎不堪，似乎经历过……一些很痛苦的事情。

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【剧情事件】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>剧情事件记录着罪恶廷根中发生的各类案件。完成剧情事件可推进罪恶廷根主线故事，逐步解锁新的支线剧情，并揭开隐藏在城市暗面中的秘密。
<Assistant_Title2>开启规则：</>
1.完成指定前置剧情事件。
2.部分事件达到等级要求。
<Assistant_Title2>助手建议：</>
1.首次进入玩法优先通关剧情事件。
2.剧情事件将解锁新的挑战事件、竞技事件以及更多剧情内容，推进玩法进度。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Story Event】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>Story Events record various cases that occur in Sinful Tingen. Completing Story Events advances the main storyline of Sinful Tingen, gradually unlocking new side quests and uncovering secrets hidden in the dark side of the city. 
<Assistant_Title2>Unlock Rules: </>
1. Complete the specified prerequisite Story Event. 
2. Some events have level requirements. 
<Assistant_Title2>Assistant's Advice: </>
1. Prioritize completing Story Events when first entering the gameplay. 
2. Story Events will unlock new Challenge Events, Competition Events, and more story content, advancing your gameplay progress.

source_cn:
致%s：
      不必灰心，成长路上总是会出现像密修会小丑这样的强敌，只要没人因此牺牲，一切都还来得及。教会的档案中，对密修会有不少记载，或许能帮到你：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302105">密修会小丑的记载</>
      相信身边的队友，在充满疯狂的非凡道路上，他们是你足以信赖的后背，而你也要尽早成长起来，成为一名出色的值夜者。 不过也别那么有压力，我看得出，你有很多特别之处，就像是曾经的我，只是需要一些小小的方式激发出来。教会这里有一套非常适合你的方案，有助于实力的快速提升，我一并附在信末了，记得查阅。
      去吧，新时代的主角，我看好你。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查阅</>
ref_en:
To %s:
      Do not be discouraged; strong enemies like the Clown of the Secret Order will always appear on the path of growth. As long as no one sacrifices themselves because of it, there is still time for everything. In the Church's archives, there are many records about the Secret Order that might help you: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302105">Records of the Secret Order Clown</>
      Trust your teammates; on the Beyonder path filled with madness, they are the backs you can rely on, and you must also grow up as soon as possible to become an outstanding Nighthawk. But do not feel too much pressure; I can see that you have many special qualities, just like I once did, and you just need a little way to stimulate them. The Church has a plan here that is very suitable for you and will help you improve your strength quickly. I have attached it to the end of the letter; remember to read it. 
      Go, protagonist of the new era; I believe in you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to read</>

source_cn:
如果你正热衷于一个浪漫的爱情故事，那么请小心——
　　也许你的大脑正被欺骗，
　　也许你的幻想产生偏移，
　　也许危险已经悄然来临。

　　我曾被爱情故事蒙骗，以为在门外、在阳光下唱歌的就是带给我快乐的英俊王子。
　　于是，我带着对所有故事里的浪漫幻想，投入了他的怀抱。
　　终于，我被无尽的灰霾笼罩，从此见到了现实。
　　我似乎已经等待了很久，等待一个英雄登场，带我奔赴自由的大海。
ref_en:
If you are currently obsessed with a romantic love story, then be careful— 
 Perhaps your brain is being deceived, 
 Perhaps your fantasies are shifting, 
 Perhaps danger has already arrived quietly. 
 
 I was once deceived by a love story, thinking that the handsome prince singing outside the door, under the sun, was the one who would bring me happiness. 
 So, I threw myself into his arms, carrying all the romantic fantasies from every story. 
 Finally, I was shrouded in endless gray haze, and from then on, I saw reality. 
 I seem to have been waiting for a long time, waiting for a hero's entrance to take me to the sea of freedom.

source_cn:
<Highlight>封印物</>：你正在使用的封印物，本质上是由某位神秘的“奇迹师”所召唤的历史投影。这种历史投影相较于原版封印物，能力有所弱化，但负面效果也有所减轻，能为非凡者带来各种提升。
其中，普通封印物分为攻击、防御、特化三种，每类封印物最多携带一件使用；特殊封印物为非凡者提供各种特殊能力，不直接提升非凡者战力。
<Highlight>封印物等级</>：普通封印物初始均为“3”级，扮演等级达到46级后可以消耗“历史回响”将封印物提升到“2”级。“3”级封印物最多可生效4条非凡物质词条效果，“2”级封印物最多可生效5条非凡物质词条效果。
<Highlight>非凡物质</>：扮演等级达到42级时，可解锁非凡物质填充。为封印物填充不同的非凡物质，能为封印物附加上各种额外的效果。
<Highlight>非凡共鸣</>：封印物填充非凡物质时，根据非凡物质的词条数量，生效额外的非凡效果，封印物等级提升，会提高非凡共鸣所能生效的最大词条数量。
<Highlight>非凡知识</>：提升非凡知识等级，能使你更好地掌控非凡之力，封印物非凡能力效果、非凡物质固定属性值与非凡共鸣属性值会随非凡知识等级提升。
<Highlight>聚合</>：扮演等级达到47级时，可解锁非凡物质聚合。将两个金色品质的非凡物质聚合成一个新的非凡物质，可能获得更多词条的非凡物质。
ref_en:
<Highlight> Sealed Artifact </>: The Sealed Artifact you are currently using is essentially a historical projection summoned by a mysterious "Miracle Invoker." Compared to the original Sealed Artifact, this historical projection has weakened abilities, but its negative effects are also reduced, and it can bring various improvements to the Beyonder. 
 Among them, ordinary Sealed Artifacts are divided into Attack, Defense, and Specialized types, with a maximum of one of each type being carried for use; Special Sealed Artifacts provide Beyonders with various special abilities and do not directly increase the Beyonder's combat power. 
 <Highlight> Sealed Artifact Level </>: Ordinary Sealed Artifacts are all initially Level 3. After reaching Acting Level 46, you can consume "Historical Echoes" to upgrade the Sealed Artifact to Level 2. A Level 3 Sealed Artifact can have up to 4 Beyonder material affix effects active, while a Level 2 Sealed Artifact can have up to 5 Beyonder material affix effects active. 
 <Highlight> Beyonder Material </>: When your Acting Level reaches 42, you can unlock Beyonder material filling. Filling the Sealed Artifact with different Beyonder materials can attach various additional effects to it. 
 <Highlight> Beyonder Resonance </>: When a Sealed Artifact is filled with Beyonder materials, additional Beyonder effects take effect based on the number of affixes on the Beyonder materials. Increasing the Sealed Artifact level will increase the maximum number of affixes that can be effective for Beyonder Resonance. 
 <Highlight> Beyonder Knowledge </>: Increasing your Beyonder Knowledge level allows you to better control Beyonder powers. The effects of the Sealed Artifact's Beyonder abilities, the fixed attribute values of Beyonder materials, and the Beyonder Resonance attribute values will all increase with the Beyonder Knowledge level. 
 <Highlight> Aggregation </>: When your Acting Level reaches 47, you can unlock Beyonder material aggregation. Aggregating two gold-quality Beyonder materials into a new Beyonder material may result in a Beyonder material with more affixes.

ref_en: Existing Gold Coin quantity, can be used for Heaven and Earth Throw.

source_cn: 廷根街头， 病重的青年艾德请你帮忙买一枚戒指、一束百合，前往书店替他回绝笔友。你购物后来到书店，藏在书柜旁等待，却看见一个糙汉大叔取走了礼物。惊讶之时，警察突然出现，揭露装病行骗是诈骗团伙的惯用伎俩。最讽刺的是，艾德装病许久，入狱体检时才发现自己真的身患重疾。骗子终将落网，而命运从不开玩笑。
ref_en: On the streets of Tingen, a seriously ill young man named Ed asks you to help him buy a ring and a bouquet of lilies to go to the bookstore and reject a pen pal on his behalf. After shopping, you arrive at the bookstore and hide beside the bookshelf to wait, but you see a rough-looking man take the gifts. Just as you are surprised, the police appear, revealing that faking illness is a common tactic used by fraud gangs. The most ironic thing is that Ed had been faking illness for a long time, and it was only during the prison medical examination that he discovered he was truly suffering from a serious illness. The scammers will eventually be caught, and fate never jokes.
